newsitem.title: USA: Millipore sells $200 mln in two-part deal.
newsitem.headline: Millipore sells $200 mln in two-part deal.

text.p: The following two-tranche debt deal from Millipore Corp was priced on Wednesday, according to lead manager JP Morgan Securities Inc.
Millipore Corp manufacturers and sells products which are used for the analysis and purification of fluids as well as the analysis, synthesis, and sequencing of nucleic acids and peptides.
